content_blocks: Aviation Academy | FAA Agent for Service
At IFOA USA, we streamline your compliance obligations by securely assigning a dependable FAA Registered Agent for Service on your behalf. Focus on flying; we handle the legalities.
Compliance success rate for our global flight personnel partners.
Updates to FAA regulations now mandate that certificate holders with a non-U.S. address must designate a domestic Agent for Service.

Recent updates to FAA Compliance Requirements now mandate that individuals and businesses holding FAA Certificates with a permanent address outside the United States must designate a U.S. Agent for Service, as outlined in 14 CFR Part 3, Subpart C. This ensures timely delivery of critical legal correspondence.
Our Agent for Service handles official FAA correspondence and legal notices so you never miss a deadline or regulatory update.

Specific guidance regarding the FTN number and IACRA portal navigation.
What is the IACRA and FTN Number?
IACRA (Integrated Airman Certification and Rating Application) is the FAA's online portal for certificates. The FTN (FAA Tracking Number) is your unique lifelong ID assigned during registration.
You MUST have an FTN to schedule knowledge exams and appoint an Agent for Service.
How do I find my FTN?
Login to your IACRA profile at iacra.faa.gov. Your FTN number is prominently displayed on your personal dashboard under your profile information.
Yes. As of July 7, 2025, all existing FAA certificate holders with a non-U.S. address must designate an agent to maintain valid certification status.
Can I appoint a corporate agent?
Yes, IFOA USA Corp serves as your official corporate Agent for Service, providing a permanent and reliable U.S. presence for all FAA-related matters.
